input.rationale: The Agreement contains no indemnification, defence or hold-harmless language anywhere: Section 9 (Warranties) stops at the Globix acknowledgement and Section 10 moves straight into General Provisions, and searches for \"indemn\", \"hold harmless\" and IP-infringement language return nothing. There is therefore no HDI IP indemnity at all, which is walk-away territory under this rule. We insert a new Section 9A after the warranty section giving HDI a duty to defend and indemnify the Company and its affiliates for third-party IP infringement claims, HDI's breach of law, HDI-caused data breaches and HDI's gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with the standard notice/control/cooperation procedure, and a reciprocal Company indemnity narrowed to the Content we supply and our own breach of law.

mappings.element: Vendor has an express duty to defend Customer and its affiliates.
Vendor indemnifies Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims.
Vendor indemnity covers claims that Services or Deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's breach of applicable law.
Vendor indemnity covers a data breach caused by Vendor.
Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
The indemnification procedure requires notice of a claim.
The indemnification procedure allocates control of the defence.
The indemnification procedure requires reasonable cooperation.
Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.

proposal.summary: Insert a new Section 9A indemnification clause: HDI defends/indemnifies the Company and its affiliates (IP infringement, breach of law, HDI-caused data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct), with notice/control/cooperation procedure and a narrow Company indemnity.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no indemnity at all, so we add HDI's defence and indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of law, HDI-caused data breaches and wilful misconduct, with a standard notice, control and cooperation procedure. Our reciprocal indemnity is deliberately confined to the Content we supply and our own breach of law.

ops.text: Indemnification. HDI shall defend and indemnify the Company and its affiliates against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Services or the Site infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (b) HDI's breach of applicable law; (c) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of the Company's data caused by HDI; or (d) HDI's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. The Company shall indemnify HDI against any third-party claim to the extent arising out of the Content provided by the Company or the Company's breach of applicable law. The indemnified Party shall give the indemnifying Party prompt written notice of the claim, the indemnifying Party shall have control of the defense and settlement of the claim, and the indemnified Party shall provide reasonable cooperation in the defense.
